protocol.scope: Six fixed, sequential exposed habit-task trials. V1 here means pre-probe repaired V2, NOT release 0.2.0. V2 means the same snapshot plus browser capability-probe guidance. Do not pool with historical arms.
protocol.prompt: 做个手机上用的学习打卡小页面。我能添加自己的学习项目，每天勾选完成，点错也能取消，看今天完成了多少。关掉再打开记录还在，能导出自己的数据。界面清爽，有一点反馈动效，先在本机用，不需要账号。
protocol.boundary:
本次只在当前工作目录制作成果，可查询公开资料和读取已启用技能。不要读取其他会话、其他测试目录或私人文件；不要安装依赖、付款、上传、公开发布或修改真实项目。使用已有工具完成能完成的工作。
Browser verification must use a profile in this workspace and an automatically assigned available port. Do not stop unrelated processes.
protocol.hypothesis: Proving a minimal browser observation before writing a full custom harness may reduce failed verification work without losing behavioral checks.
protocol.acceptance: Independent real browser checks for add/check/undo/count/reload/export/literal names/mobile layout/date reopen. Retain all generation failures and uncertainty. Inspect command logs for actual adoption and tool failures; lower counters alone are not proof.
protocol.limitations: One task, one model, three repetitions per variant; exposed task, not new holdout. Sequential alternating order reduces simultaneous local interference, not all temporal or sampling confounds.

scope: Counters only; these before/after variants are both repaired V2, not historical release V1. Independent quality and adoption review is separate.
